component.name: Libera Suite
component.summary: Documents, spreadsheets, presentations and diagrams, on your own machine

description.p: Libera Suite is a desktop office suite: a word processor, a spreadsheet, a presentation editor and a Visio viewer. It opens the documents other people send you, edits them on your machine and saves them back. There is no account to create, no document server, and nothing in it that reports back.

Libera Suite includes components from Euro-Office, itself a fork of ONLYOFFICE by Ascensio System SIA. Those components are free software under the GNU AGPL v3 and are modified. The exact upstream revisions each build came from, and every change applied to them, are published with the source; the application prints them with libera --payload-status.
The host around those components is written by Abilian and is Apache-2.0. Both licences, and how to obtain the corresponding source, are on the documentation site.
File ▸ New creates a document, a spreadsheet or a presentation from any window, and the editor's own Create New asks which of the three.
Opening a document while Libera Suite is running hands it to the running instance, and About names the upstream components and their licence.
